name: guava
readme_excerpt: Guava: Google Core Libraries for Java Guava is a set of core Java libraries from Google that includes new collection types (such as multimap and multiset), immutable collections, a graph library, and utilities for concurrency, I/O, hashing, primitives, strings, and more! It is widely used on most Java projects within Google, and widely used by many other companies as well. Guava comes in two flavors: The JRE flavor requires JDK 1.8 or higher.
